item.title: Wrist MWM With Active Flexion / Extension
clinicalUse: Painful wrist movement with an immediate correctable sign
contact: Manual contact or belt at carpal region depending on glide direction.
forceDirection: Sustain the accessory glide while the patient actively flexes/extends the wrist.
Direction is adjusted until movement is pain-free or clearly easier.
safety: Avoid acute fracture/instability or unhealed surgical restriction.
item.visualCue: Accessory carpal glide + active wrist movement → pain-free gain should remain on retest.

subTechniques.name: Wrist MWM + Active Extension
subTechniques.clinicalGoal: Improve a painful wrist-extension comparable sign when an accessory glide makes the movement immediately easier.
subTechniques.patientSetup: Sitting with forearm supported and wrist free to move.
subTechniques.contact: Apply the selected pain-free accessory glide across the wrist while stabilizing the forearm.
subTechniques.direction: Maintain the glide while the patient actively extends the wrist or performs the exact painful weight-bearing movement.
subTechniques.dosage: 6–10 repetitions × 2–3 sets only while the PILL response is present.
subTechniques.reassess: Wrist extension and weight-bearing through the hand.
subTechniques.clinicalPearl: The glide direction is chosen by immediate improvement—not by habit.
subTechniques.safetyNote: Avoid acute carpal instability or fracture.
